entries.title: Fermat in the unit group
entries.summary: Every unit of ZMod p raised to p - 1 is one when p is prime.
entries.statementType: ∀ (p : Nat) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (u : Units (ZMod p)), Eq (instHPow.hPow u (instHSub.hSub p 1)) 1
entries.certificateType: ∀ (p : Nat) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (u : Units (ZMod p)), Eq (instHPow.hPow u (instHSub.hSub p 1)) 1

entries.title: Fermat for nonzero residues
entries.summary: A nonzero residue modulo a prime raised to p - 1 is one.
entries.statementType: ∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ZMod p}, Ne a 0 → Eq (instHPow.hPow a (instHSub.hSub p 1)) 1
entries.certificateType: ∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ZMod p}, Ne a 0 → Eq (instHPow.hPow a (instHSub.hSub p 1)) 1

entries.title: Fermat in ZMod
entries.summary: Every residue modulo a prime satisfies a^p = a.
entries.statementType: ∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ZMod p), Eq (instHPow.hPow a p) a
entries.certificateType: ∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ZMod p), Eq (instHPow.hPow a p) a

entries.title: Fermat for coprime integers
entries.summary: The integer form a^(p-1) = 1 modulo p when p does not divide a.
entries.statementType:
∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : Int},
  Not (Int.instDvd.dvd p.cast a) → Eq (instHPow.hPow a.cast (instHSub.hSub p 1)) 1
entries.certificateType:
∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : Int},
  Not (Int.instDvd.dvd p.cast a) → Eq (instHPow.hPow a.cast (instHSub.hSub p 1)) 1

entries.title: Fermat for every integer
entries.summary: For every integer a and prime p, a^p = a modulo p.
entries.statementType: ∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : Int), Eq (instHPow.hPow a.cast p) a.cast
entries.certificateType: ∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : Int), Eq (instHPow.hPow a.cast p) a.cast
